commands:
nft add table inet f2b-table
nft -- add chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain \{ type filter hook input priority -1 \; \}
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo '10000' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo '10000' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi

{ nft flush set inet f2b-table <addr_set> 2> /dev/null; } || {
{ nft -a list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | sed -nE 's/.*@<addr_set>\s+.*\s+\#\s*(handle\s+[0-9]+)$/\1/p'; } | while read -r hdl; do
nft delete rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $hdl; done
nft delete set inet f2b-table <addr_set>
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo '10000' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo '10000' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi
}
nft list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | grep -q '@<addr_set>[ \t]'
^(\S+ )?\[(?:IPv6:<IP6>|<IP4>)\]( \(may be forged\))?: possible SMTP attack: command=AUTH, count=\d+$
^AUTH failure \([^\)]+\):(?: [^:]+:)? (?:authentication failure|user not found): [^,]*, (?:user=<F-USER>(?:\S+|.*?)</F-USER>, )?relay=(?:\S+ )?\[(?:IPv6:<IP6>|<IP4>)\](?: \(may be forged\))?$

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto -j f2b-sendmail-auth
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-sendmail-auth
<iptables> -X f2b-sendmail-auth

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto -j f2b-sendmail-auth
done; done

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto -j f2b-ejabberd-auth
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-ejabberd-auth
<iptables> -X f2b-ejabberd-auth

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto -j f2b-ejabberd-auth
done; done

files.jail.local:
[ejabberd-auth]
enabled = true
backend = systemd
bantime = 10m
action = iptables-allports[name=%(__name__)s]
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=more]
port = http,https
[sendmail-auth]
enabled = true
backend = gamin
action = iptables-allports[name=%(__name__)s]
ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8
[webmin-auth]
enabled = true
maxretry = 0
